README_FIRST: Sanitized template. Each key is a node id_a (32 hex chars = 16 bytes), value is {label, pk_a, shs_b}. pk_a (130 hex chars = 65-byte uncompressed P-256 point) comes from the real device's one-time provisioning-export serial printout -- it cannot be generated on a host. shs_b (64 hex chars = 32 bytes) is this node's own per-node server verifier, generated fresh by tools/register_puf_node.py at registration time -- never reused across nodes. Register a real node with tools/register_puf_node.py. Real captured values never committed -- see ERRATA.md / Materials Availability.
